claims.statement: Joe Coburn is reported to be Tom Allen's second in the approaching fight with Mace on 10 May 1870.
claims.excerpt: Coburn, it is reported, will be the second of Allen.

claims.statement: Tom Allen is to fight Mace in the approaching mill on 10 May 1870.
claims.excerpt: the approaching mill with Mace on the 10th of May.

fights.notes: Planned bout as of 21 April 1870; the paper gives only 'Mace' as the opponent.
